subject: Hospitality
title: The Power of Google in Hotel Search
description: A 60-second lesson on The Power of Google in Hotel Search.

hook.text: Google now shows hotel prices and availability directly in search results—cutting into both OTA and hotel direct traffic.

buildup.text: Google Hotel Ads lets hotels bid on placement alongside OTAs. Guests can compare and book without leaving Google.

discovery.text: Hotels pay Google per click (CPC) rather than a commission per booking. For many, this is cheaper than OTA commissions.

twist.text: Google becomes the real gatekeeper. Both OTAs and hotels now pay Google for visibility—adding a new cost layer for everyone.

climax.text: The distribution landscape keeps adding middlemen: hotels → OTAs → metasearch → Google. The guest pays for all of them.

punchline.text: Hotels pay OTAs who pay Google. The guest funds every middleman.

quiz.question: How does Google Hotel Ads differ from OTA commissions?
options: Hotels pay per click rather than a percentage commission per booking
